$comment: Defects that were PRESENT while the gate reported a pass. This is the escape-rate instrument the portfolio package names as missing: 'The rubric can be wrong, and nothing in the loop detects a rule that passes bad code. Escape rate, meaning defects found after a passing gate, is the metric that would catch it, and it is not instrumented yet.' Every entry below is a real event from the 2026-08-05/06 sessions with a verifiable artifact. Rates are COMPUTED by escape-rate.mjs, never written here.

escapes.defect: The logo role never ran. design-refs/logos held only a README: no candidate marks, no gallery, no DECISION.md. A single brand-mark.jpg was copied into mark-01.png and shipped.
escapes.whyGateMissed: The gate scores what was built. It cannot ask for a step that was never started, and no rule required the logo role to have run.
escapes.nowCaughtBy: process-map logo contract (public/brand-mark.png + gallery.html + DECISION.md naming mark-05) with dependsOn ordering

escapes.defect: Three chosen architectures shipped as one page shell with only the results region swapping. The map view did not open on a map; the dates view did not open on a calendar.
escapes.whyGateMissed: The orchestrator's own DECISION.md required the homogenisation ('presentation only', 'one palette app-wide'). The build was compliant, so no rule fired.
escapes.nowCaughtBy: process-map layout contract requiring the word 'Forbidden' in DECISION.md (mobile-ux R38)

escapes.defect: Colour and type were never a choice axis. The coral base shipped because the orchestrator picked it, bundled with the winning layout.
escapes.whyGateMissed: No palette step existed in the process, so nothing could require one.
escapes.nowCaughtBy: process-map palette step + palette role in the registry + mobile-ux E0b

escapes.defect: style-src 'self' blocked the Google Fonts stylesheet, so DM Sans never loaded in production and every route rendered in a fallback face. A console error on all 18 page loads.
escapes.whyGateMissed: Local renders carry no CSP header, so the defect existed only on the deployed build and no check drove the deployed build's console.
escapes.nowCaughtBy: evidence/shoot-petsitter.mjs console assertion across 3 views x 3 widths x 2 themes on the production URL

escapes.defect: A 'Sample Sitter' row (id='sample', bio 'Sample profile used by resource-link probes') was live in production D1 and served to users as a ninth sitter, rendering as an 'SS' initials map pin.
escapes.whyGateMissed: Two checks built detail URLs by substituting the literal string 'sample', so the row was inserted to make them resolve. The check was satisfied by faking the data.
escapes.nowCaughtBy: fe-resource-links and fe-breadcrumbs now resolve a real id from the collection and FAIL with 'no real detail id available' rather than falling back to a literal

escapes.defect: DECISION.md claimed home and detail at 375 and 1280 in both themes. Ten renders existed: detail for one option only, desktop in light only, no dark desktop.
escapes.whyGateMissed: A requirements list inside a decision document was read as evidence the requirements were met. Nothing counted artifacts against the claim.
escapes.nowCaughtBy: process-map visual contract requiring 12 DISTINCT sha256 in renders/MANIFEST.json (mobile-ux R36)

escapes.defect: Eight avatar photographs of apparent real people, with no SOURCES.md, no metadata and no licence, were about to ship labelled as named pet sitters.
escapes.whyGateMissed: No rule asked where an image came from. fe-brand-mark checks that a mark exists, not that it is ours.
escapes.nowCaughtBy: mobile-ux R37 (every image asset carries provenance or it does not ship); avatars regenerated via image_gen with SOURCES.md

knownBlindSpots.statement: There is no measured agreement between judge verdicts and human labels. No true-positive or true-negative rate, no alignment target.
Excluding inapplicable lanes from the denominator keeps the score honest but means a lane misclassified as inapplicable inflates the score with no visible failure.
